name: caltrop
drawCalls: 1 (CaltropSwarm, all instances; +1 with outline in B/C)
notes: Four-point red star with ridge-creased points, dark hub, red sensor eye on the -Z face, dark secondary points behind. Spin around local Z is done in the vertex shader (per-instance phase). API: buildCaltrop(params,seed), new CaltropSwarm(capacity,params?,seed?).set(i,pos,quat,scale,flash)/setCount/update(time).
